standard_prerequisites.name: Very ampleness can be checked after restricting to an affine covering of the base
The affine characterisation of ampleness and very ampleness of powers
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemma \ref{lemma-finite-type-over-affine-ample-very-ample} and Properties, Proposition \ref{properties-proposition-characterize-ample}, cited at proof lines 9654-9656 and 9668-9670
standard_prerequisites.use: Make a twist globally generated and give the immersion.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine base (proof lines 9652-9653).
Choose a twist that is globally generated and its generating sections (proof lines 9654-9662).
Build the comparison morphism to projective space (proof lines 9663-9667).
Add higher-power sections to upgrade to an immersion and conclude (proof lines 9668-9694).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the affine case (proof lines 9652-9653).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite type morphism over a quasi-compact base and a relatively ample invertible sheaf, tensoring any invertible sheaf with a sufficiently high power of the ample one gives a relatively very ample sheaf. The proof reduces to an affine base, uses the affine characterisation to make a suitable twist globally generated, chooses generating sections and the induced morphism to projective space, and then refines it by adding sections of higher powers of the ample sheaf, which produces the immersion required for very ampleness.
